corpus: M3 checksum-pinned 300-file common-static corpus; unchanged djxl 0.12.0 reference PPM pixels
methodology: Every supported input is independently opened, nearest-resized and encoded to each of five formats. All output files are decoded with libvips. PNG, lossless WebP and TIFF retain the M3 independent source tolerance of max 1/RMSE 0.55 against djxl. JPEG quality 100 4:4:4 and AVIF 4:2:0 must exactly match equivalent transcodes of the already oracle-checked PNG thumbnail, decoded by libvips. Identical target input samples avoid amplifying allowed source rounding through lossy quantization. This composition checks source accuracy and pipeline integration; it does not establish new target-codec quality claims. No performance claims are made from this correctness run.
